players.name: Roquan Smith
players.comment: Smith finished with eight tackles (two solo) in Thursday's Week 9 loss to Jacksonville.

players.name: Nate Wiggins
players.comment: Wiggins (illness) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

players.name: Malaki Starks
players.comment: Starks finished Baltimore's Week 9 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday with four tackles (three solo) and a forced fumble.

players.name: Riley Patterson
players.comment: Patterson will be the Ravens' kicker for Monday night's game against the Chargers, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Rashod Bateman
players.comment: Bateman (calf) was listed as a full participant on Friday's practice estimation.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.comment: Lane did not draw a target Thursday in a loss to Jacksonville.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.comment: Ahead of Week 10, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter noted "I expect (Brissett) to be our starter" next Monday against the Chargers, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.comment: The Ravens aren't expected to deal Henry before Tuesday's trade deadline, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Daiyan Henley
players.comment: Henley remains with the Chargers, as the Broncos have backed out of trading for the linebacker, Jeff Legwold of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Cameron Dicker
players.comment: Dicker went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT during Sunday's 44-22 loss to Houston.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.comment: Harris (calf) was a full participant in Friday's practice.

players.name: Justin Herbert
players.comment: Herbert (finger) doesn't appear on the the Chargers' injury report ahead of Monday night's game against the Ravens.

players.name: Charlie Kolar
players.comment: Kolar brought in all three of his targets for 31 yards in a 44-22 loss to the Texans on Sunday.
